messages:
marc: Quick sync 1 1 I opened a docs PR with a short FAQ entry clarifying tier billing rounding rules (per-minute vs per-second billing). QA wanted an explicit example showing cost calc for a 73-second request.

sophia: Good idea. Could you add a small calc table showing math? e.g., 73s => rounded to 120s under 'per-minute' billing at 0.0005 USD/s -> $0.06.

ben: Also mention how dedicated reserved capacity billing is monthly and not affected by per-request rounding.

marc: Added both notes and a small JS snippet showing how to pre-calc estimated cost with `estimateTokenCost()` helper.

marc: CI ran and passed, merging once ben approves.

docs-bot: PR #4201 merged into main by marc. Release note: "Billing rounding FAQ + calc example."
